name: Exec Cluster E03: Position Sizing Modes — Percent, Unit, Notional
description: Tests: position_size with all 3 type modes (percent, unit, notional) + equal_weight + rebalance_on
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER E03: Position Sizing Modes
# Tests: position_size percent/unit/notional, equal_weight, rebalance_on
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === SIGNAL: SMA trend filter ===
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)
is_above = close > sma_200
is_below = close < sma_200

# === REBALANCE BOUNDARY ===
is_new_month = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month)(index())

# === ENTRY/EXIT gated to rebalance ===
enter_long = is_new_month and is_above
exit_long = is_new_month and is_below
held = hold_until(enter_long, exit_long)

# === EQUAL WEIGHT across active assets ===
weights = equal_weight()(active_mask=held)

# === EXECUTION ===
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# E03: percent mode with equal_weight + rebalance_on
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_month)

# Protective stop
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.percent)(distance=10)
